title: (Pwn2Own) NVIDIA GPU Display Drivers FINN Serializer Untrusted Pointer Dereference Information Disclosure Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows local attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of NVIDIA GPU Display Drivers. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system, even if only within a container, in order to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the NVIDIA Resource Manager. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied value prior to dereferencing it as a pointer. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of the kernel on the target host system.
addtionnal_details:
NVIDIA has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://nvidia.custhelp.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/5861/~/security-bulletin%3A-nvidia-gpu-display-driver---september-2026
